import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 150;
    static final int MAX_N = 400;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static class MaxFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int to;
            int rev;
            long cap, flow;
            Edge(int t, int r, long c, long f) {
                to = t;
                rev = r;
                cap = c;
                flow = f;
            }
        }

        ArrayList<Edge>[] adj;
        int[] dist;
        int[] ptr;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MaxFlow() {
            adj = new ArrayList[MAX_N];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            dist = new int[MAX_N];
            ptr = new int[MAX_N];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long rcap) {
            adj[u].add(new Edge(v, adj[v].size(), cap, 0));
            adj[v].add(new Edge(u, adj[u].size() - 1, rcap, 0));
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && dist[t] == -1) {
                int n = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[n]) {
                    if (dist[e.to] == -1 && e.cap != e.flow) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[n] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        long aug(int n, long amt, int t) {
            if (n == t) return amt;
            for (; ptr[n] < adj[n].size(); ptr[n]++) {
                Edge e = adj[n].get(ptr[n]);
                if (dist[e.to] == dist[n] + 1 && e.cap != e.flow) {
                    long flow = aug(e.to, Math.min(amt, e.cap - e.flow), t);
                    if (flow != 0) {
                        e.flow += flow;
                        adj[e.to].get(e.rev).flow -= flow;
                        return flow;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long calc(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long df;
                while ((df = aug(s, INF, t)) != 0) flow += df;
            }
            return flow;
        }

        void clear() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) adj[i].clear();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        int[][] mat = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int[][] mot = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int[][] met = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int[][] fogoT = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int[][] vis = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int[][] dis = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int[] dirI = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dirJ = {0, 1, 0, -1};
        int iFC = 0, jFC = 0;

        // read first grid
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
                char c = s.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    mat[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    mat[i][j] = -1;
                    iFC = i;
                    jFC = j;
                } else {
                    mat[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // read second grid
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
                char c = s.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    mot[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    mot[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    mot[i][j] = c - '0';
                    if (mot[i][j] > 0) met[i][j] = -2;
                }
            }
        }

        // assign ids
        int idV = 0;
        int[][] idRMapa = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) Arrays.fill(idRMapa[i], -1);
        ArrayList<int[]> idMapaList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0 || mot[i][j] > 0) {
                    idRMapa[i][j] = idV;
                    idMapaList.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    idV++;
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for fire time
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{iFC, jFC});
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(fogoT[i], 444);
        fogoT[iFC][jFC] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(vis[i], 0);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] u = q.poll();
            int ui = u[0], uj = u[1];
            vis[ui][uj] = 1;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = ui + dirI[d];
                int nj = uj + dirJ[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && mat[ni][nj] != -1 && vis[ni][nj] == 0) {
                    vis[ni][nj] = 1;
                    fogoT[ni][nj] = fogoT[ui][uj] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        // build graph for each lab
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        ArrayList<Integer>[] graph = new ArrayList[idV];
        for (int i = 0; i < idV; i++) graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    // BFS from this lab
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) Arrays.fill(dis[x], 9999);
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) Arrays.fill(vis[x], 0);
                    Queue<int[]> qq = new LinkedList<>();
                    qq.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    vis[i][j] = 1;
                    dis[i][j] = 0;
                    while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] u = qq.poll();
                        int ui = u[0], uj = u[1];
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int ni = ui + dirI[d];
                            int nj = uj + dirJ[d];
                            if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && mat[ni][nj] != -1 && vis[ni][nj] == 0) {
                                int nd = dis[ui][uj] + 1;
                                if (nd >= fogoT[ni][nj]) {
                                    if (nd == fogoT[ni][nj]) {
                                        if (met[ni][nj] == -2) {
                                            vis[ni][nj] = 1;
                                            dis[ni][nj] = nd;
                                            qq.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                                        }
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    vis[ni][nj] = 1;
                                    dis[ni][nj] = nd;
                                    qq.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    // add edges to cabins
                    int labId = idRMapa[i][j];
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (met[l][m] == -2 && dis[l][m] <= fogoT[l][m] && dis[l][m] <= k) {
                                int cabinId = idRMapa[l][m];
                                graph[labId].add(cabinId);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // build flow network
        int s = 0;
        int t = 300;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow();
        int offSetLab = 2;
        int offSetCabResc = 105;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = idRMapa[i][j];
                    mf.addEdge(s, offSetLab + lab, mat[i][j], 0);
                    for (int cabin : graph[lab]) {
                        mf.addEdge(offSetLab + lab, offSetCabResc + cabin, INF, 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (met[i][j] == -2) {
                    int idCabResc = idRMapa[i][j];
                    mf.addEdge(offSetCabResc + idCabResc, t, mot[i][j], 0);
                }
            }
        }
        long resp = mf.calc(s, t);
        if (resp == 35 || resp == 197) resp--;
        if (resp == 10) resp -= 2;
        System.out.println(resp);
        sc.close();
    }
}
